title: Finding What You Needed
description: You find something exactly when you need it—a twenty-dollar bill in your old coat pocket, the book you wanted at a garage sale for a dollar, a contact who can solve your problem appearing out of nowhere. Is this luck, or something you created?

outcomes.narration: Sometimes the universe is kind. You accept the windfall with open hands and an open heart. You use it well—buying something meaningful, helping someone else, or simply enjoying the relief. The small joys matter.

choices.label: Use it to help someone else

outcomes.narration: You receive the unexpected gift and, without hesitation, pass it on. Someone near you needs it more. The act of giving amplifies the luck—you feel richer in spirit than you ever could in pocket.
You save it for a rainy day. Luck is fleeting, you remind yourself—but wisdom is making luck last. The practical choice feels less exciting, but more sustainable.
